title: Jashn E Mumbai
summary: Lead Hosts for Jashn E Mumbai.
description:
Lead Hosts for Jashn E Mumbai. Jashn-E-Mumbai’s Cultural Night, followed by the DG-DRR Dinner, brought together 600+ attendees, including 40+ Rotaractors from 13 domestic districts and 4 international districts: Nepal, Tanzania, Kenya, and Mexico, reflecting strong regional and international participation. The event was supported by Rotary Club of Mumbai Juhu as Lead Hosts.

The evening commenced with Regal District Governor Rtn. Rajan Dua’s keynote address, followed by an energetic Bollywood jamming session by Divyaansh Raaj and Jams and Vibes. The Maha Aarti added a spiritual and traditional touch, followed by a vibrant cultural performance by Team JOSH from RCSIES.
